question: Does a surge with volume expansion AND aligned aggressor flow ('backed') extend further over the next 5 minutes than one without?
why_it_must_be_forward: ⚠⚠ SUPERSEDED 2026-09-30 — THIS RATIONALE IS FACTUALLY WRONG. The lake holds ~49 sessions of `aggressor`: `prune_capture` trims only the HOT tier, while `tape_mirror` has been exporting the full `ticks` table to the lake with the column intact all along (46 MNQ partitions from 2026-07-24, ~54M ticks, more on B2). The operator caught it: "why are we pruning aggressor at 5 says? we have an endless data lake". I had read the pruner and stopped there. See the next key for what this does and does not change.
\u26a0 rationale_corrected_2026-09-30: NOTHING IN `frozen` MOVES, and no n, session count or verdict rule changes — a changed parameter restarts the count at zero. The forward design STANDS, on the narrower and still-valid ground that 2026-09-18→24 is where the idea was FOUND, so only sessions from 2026-09-25 are out-of-sample. What the correction DOES change: this question is now also answerable BACKWARDS on the lake, and such a run is IN-SAMPLE by construction — it must be reported as a separate, weaker estimate and may never be substituted for this one. ORIGINAL TEXT, PRESERVED VERBATIM: `aggressor` exists only in capture.db `ticks`, which prune_capture keeps for FIVE DAYS. There is no history to widen this with and there never will be. Either the readings are written down as they happen or the question stays open forever.

frozen.surge_definition_note: 90th percentile of the |1-minute move| over the 5 sessions available on 2026-09-24. FROZEN. Changing it restarts the count.
frozen.pulse_definition: minute volume / MEDIAN of the previous 15 minutes OF THE SAME SESSION
frozen.flow_definition: (buy-sell)/(buy+sell) by aggressor over the surge minute. 'neutral' EXCLUDED, never split.
frozen.outcome: cont_pt = (close at +5min - close at surge) * direction of the surge

verdict_rule: BACKED must beat UNBACKED on median cont_pt with NON-OVERLAPPING DAY-CLUSTERED bootstrap CIs. Minutes inside a session are not independent draws; a per-observation interval here is inflated roughly tenfold and would declare a winner from noise.

in_sample_not_a_result.note: This is the window the idea was FOUND in. Its numbers are NOT evidence and must never be quoted as the result. First eligible session is 2026-09-25.

the_meters_do_not_depend_on_this: PULSE and FLOW are DESCRIPTIVE and ship regardless — they say what is happening now, which the operator asked for. This pre-registration only tests the separate, stronger claim that 'backed' also predicts continuation.
